verdict.rationale: Gusto's Business Compliance product documents 'Proactive Compliance Alerts' that notify customers of upcoming compliance deadlines and new obligations, including annual reports and annual tax reminders, which covers the reminder half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows a calendar or consolidated view of upcoming filing deadlines. Missing for 10: a documented compliance calendar/deadline view, detail on reminder timing and lead time before each deadline, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the alerts.
